trailhead.label: The Schäfer shop in Moos, the board’s start

cautions: About 200 m beside the SS52 in Moos at the start: keep your dog on a short lead.
Steep, narrow paths above the Klammbachalm: sure footing needed, for you and your dog.
High, open ridge at 2,000–2,550 m with no shade: storms build quickly on summer afternoons.
Carry water even though water points are listed.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.
